exp1.role: Core Local Commerce | AI Product Manager Intern
exp1.description: Incubated the “AI Co-creation Community” from 0-to-1 to address repetitive work and AI adoption barriers. Built the product end-to-end with AI coding to incubate efficiency tools and share AI knowledge across the org.
achievements: User Research: Surveyed **50+** ops and product staff and identified **8** core efficiency scenarios. Led product architecture with a “Project Incubation–Info Sharing–Tool Integration” loop and delivered PRD and state diagrams.
Product Planning: Designed “Home”, “Projects”, “News”, “Tutorials”, and “Tools” modules with feature maps and state machines.
AI Full-Stack Development: Delivered core modules with AI coding (no dedicated dev team), cutting the dev cycle by **75%**.
Operations: Zero-cost launch with **41** AI efficiency projects in 2 months across **5** business lines, validating the “company-wide co-creation” model.

exp2.description: Led product strategy and operations for “Yuanstore”, QQ’s IP merchandise marketplace for anime and gaming collectibles.
achievements: B2B Supply Chain: Designed batch upload system and SOPs. Doubled listing efficiency, driving weekly GMV up **25%**.
Customer Service: Built monitoring dashboards and alerts. Response rate improved from **40%** to **90%**, with zero complaints in the quarter.
Commercialization: Standardized campaign templates and launched promotions, driving monthly GMV from **469K** to **811K** (**+73%**).
Data-Driven Merchandising: Built an IP heat evaluation model. Expanded direct supply **4x** and onboarded **2** top-tier suppliers.

exp3.role: Weibo Fashion | New Media Operations Intern
exp3.description: Content creation, brand promotion, and ad placement for Weibo Fashion matrix accounts.
achievements: AI & Tooling: Optimized AI copywriting prompts and built a lightweight ad placement tool, boosting placement speed by **200%**.
Viral Growth: Launched a trend campaign that achieved **1.33B** total reads.

proj1.description: Applied boosting to federated learning with differential privacy strategies, balancing privacy preservation and model performance.
highlights: Optimized distributed ensemble training with boosting and a Gaussian noise mechanism for privacy.
Implemented knowledge distillation to reduce client–server communication cost.
Validated strong adaptability to heterogeneous data while maintaining privacy-performance balance.
